headline: Fighting Returns to Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the last edition, the Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse have returned to the center of the fight. Stlican Shelf posted eight strategic-base ownership events in the latest two-hour window, matching its six-hour count of eight and carrying its day's ledger to fifty-eight. Weathered Expanse generated three events in the latest two hours, with its most recent exchange arriving at the cutoff, and holds fifty-seven events over twenty-four hours. Godcrofts has grown busier, adding nine events in the last two hours and twenty-five in six, with The Axehead its most contested base. Fisherman's Row continues, though its pace has cooled to three events over the latest two hours. Linn Mercy and Callahan's Passage each produced two recent events; Stonecradle, busy in the previous edition, has recorded none in the last two hours. The contest remains undecided, as neither side commands the thirty-four victory towns needed for conquest.
